description:
Watch videos together, perfectly in sync, no matter where your friends and family are. 

SyncTogether is a modern, low-latency shared media player crafted specifically for macOS. Whether you're streaming YouTube videos or watching local movies from your Mac, SyncTogether keeps everyone's playback in lockstep. When someone plays, pauses, or seeks, everyone stays synchronized automatically.

KEY FEATURES:

• STRICT LOCKSTEP PLAYBACK
Synchronization engine with automatic drift correction and readiness gating. Play, pause, scrub, and seek together without getting out of sync. Late joiners are instantly synced to the host's current position.

• TWO VERSATILE PLAYBACK MODES
- YouTube Integration: Paste any public YouTube link or playlist to start watching together immediately.
- Local Video Files: Watch MP4, MKV, MOV, WebM, and other video files on your drive with hardware-accelerated playback. Built-in hash verification ensures everyone is watching the exact same file.

• LIVE VOICECAMS & FACECAMS
Bring your watch party to life! Multi-participant live audio and video tiles let you see and hear your friends' real-time reactions right alongside the video without leaving the app.

• REAL-TIME CHAT & ANIMATED REACTIONS
Engage during the stream with built-in instant messaging, live typing indicators, and expressive animated emoji reactions that float across the screen.

• INSTANT ROOMS & INVITE LINKS
Create private watch party rooms in seconds. Share a simple 6-character room code or send an invite link (synctogether://join/code) for one-click joining.

• MADE FOR COUPLES & LONG-DISTANCE
Pair two accounts and get Our Room, a free private room that's always yours. Plan date nights across time zones with a reminder before they start, build a weekly streak, keep your history, count down to your reunion and share a year card. Pairing is free for any two signed-in accounts.

• PRIVACY-FIRST & SECURE
No ads, and your personal data is never sold. Join instantly as an anonymous guest with one click, or sign in securely with Apple ID, Google, or Email OTP.

• NATIVE MACOS EXPERIENCE
Tailored for macOS with keyboard shortcuts, picture-in-picture, full-screen theater mode, and a distraction-free dark cinema aesthetic.

Start your next movie night or video watch party today with SyncTogether!

SYNCTOGETHER PATRON (OPTIONAL)
Patron is an auto-renewing subscription, available monthly or yearly, that unlocks up to 16 watchers per room, up to 20 active rooms, persistent rooms, video facecams, watch sessions up to 24 hours and extended animated reactions. If either partner in a pair is a Patron, you both can plan date nights and see your full history. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://synctogether.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://synctogether.app/privacy
promotionalText: Movie night, even when you're apart. Pair with your person for a free private room, date nights across time zones and a weekly streak. Free on Mac.
whatsNew:
FOR COUPLES & LONG-DISTANCE
• PAIR WITH YOUR PARTNER: Connect two accounts and you get your own private room, free, that's always open for the two of you.
• DATE NIGHTS: Plan a movie night even across time zones. Each of you sees it at your own local time.
• YOUR STREAK & HISTORY: Watch together each week to build your Our streak, and look back at everything you've watched.
• REMINDERS: Get a notification when your partner is ready or a date night is about to start.
• NICKNAMES & COUNTDOWN: Give each other nicknames and count down the days until you meet.
• OUR YEAR CARD: A shareable summary of your year together.
• FILM STAYS PUT: After a shared film ends, it stays in your room, so you can pick it up again.

EVERYTHING ELSE
• SMOOTHER LOOK: Times, dates and counters now move only where the numbers change, so the app feels calmer.
• NEW DATE & TIME PICKER: Choosing a date or time looks and feels like the rest of the app.
• BACK WITH ESC: On desktop, press Esc to go back.
• FIXES: Shared videos stream more reliably. The badge list scrolls properly, and the profile buttons work as they should.
